issues: The ARCH.md objective specifies an offscreen terrain chunk cache to re-render only dirty/visible chunks. The implementation instead iterates over every visible tile every frame inside _renderTerrainAndResources, lacking offscreen canvas chunk caching.

Potential memory leak / stale listener leak in destroy() and window listeners: window event listeners for mousedown, mousemove, mouseup, keydown, keyup are attached globally to window instead of bound correctly or cleaned up if multiple Renderer instances are ever instantiated.

Avoid allocations in hot loops: new renderItems objects, closure functions inside renderItems.push({ draw: () => {} }), and particle object splices/pushes occur every frame, failing the zero-allocations per-frame requirement.
